summary: A mixed day led by e-commerce regulatory tightening and Reliance's major capital move. Consumer Protection Rules 2026 reshape platform governance while Reliance lines up its second $1 billion bond sale in three weeks.

bullets.text: Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) (Amendment) Rules 2026 shift focus from consumer disclosure to platform governance requirements.
Reliance plans second $1 billion bond sale in three weeks ahead of RBI decision on local currency issuance.
Consumer electronics and appliance brands plan 5-8% price hikes starting October 1 across ACs, TVs, and durables.
Gold prices fell Rs 3,200/10 grams; silver dropped Rs 6,700/kg as rising oil prices fuel rate hike expectations.
TakeMe2Space launches India's first orbital computing satellite on SpaceX rocket October 1 to process data in orbit.
